title: WordPress Publishing (XML-RPC)
description: Publish to this site from writing apps that already support WordPress — MarsEdit, Byword, Ulysses, Open Live Writer. Requires an API key scoped to XML-RPC publishing plus the blog collections you want to publish into. Available on Pro and higher editions.

enable.label: Enable XML-RPC Publishing
enable.help: Master switch. When off, /xmlrpc.php and /xmlrpc/{collection} return 404 — indistinguishable from a site without the feature. Off by default because an exposed xmlrpc.php is a standard security-scanner finding.

ratePerIp.label: Rate Limit (per minute per IP)
ratePerIp.help: Maximum XML-RPC requests per minute from one IP address. The XML parser runs before credentials are checked, so this bounds how much work an anonymous caller can force. Set to 0 to disable.
